title: Only 4,490 US Newspapers Remain
hook: Local news feels everywhere. Entire towns have lost their watchdogs.
closing: Fewer newspapers mean fewer eyes on decisions shaping your town.
question: Do you know your local reporter?

segments.say: US newspapers fell by 2,835, removing local watchdogs from communities across the country.
Now 208 counties have no local news source, leaving public decisions with less scrutiny.
About 15% of Americans have little or no local news, missing information that shapes their communities.
